pilots: box inherited from steer@3; a pilot of 48 random designs on the training prompts with these concepts gave uniq 5/50/95 .28/.55/.74 and tiers met 8, 17, 39 of 48, so the box was kept

methods.additive: the band lines give each output as base plus a sum of one-band curves (linear interpolation in u); each cell is solved on that model by differential evolution on the baselines' loss, the answer evaluated, the model shifted by the observed residual and solved again, query_iter evaluations per cell
methods.line: steer@2's knob: one raw gain on every band of the task's concepts (negative for a lowered one), the line grid per task
methods.band: the best band-line point, one band of one concept at a time
methods.de: differential evolution on the cell at tier 2 (the baselines' loss: minus the score plus a steep penalty outside the cell), de_maxiter generations of 24, per task
methods.lookup: the best point of the design of experiments
methods.target: design of experiments, one model, then each cell as one query: each raised concept at least t past the zero design, each lowered one at least t below it, where t is the cell's best design-point score plus reach (log10(2) where no design point meets the cell); uniq and coh at least the tier, drift at most drift_max; starts at the best design point; query_iter evaluations

claims.model: over the 24 task-tier cells on the held-out prompts, the target queries beat the additive model in more cells than they lose; the same count against line, band, de and lookup is reported whichever way it falls
claims.climb: on training prompts, the target queries beat the design lookup in at least 8 of the 24 cells

after: steer@3 (PR 1809) and steer@3b (PR 1811): same bands, box, tiers, drift limit, prompts and baselines; new concepts and a new model
